UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Synced Google account profile and cloud sync metadata stored per authenticated user.

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: A cooking recipe with ingredient list, preparation instructions, costs, portable image data URI or URL, and cooking times.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recipe (document ID)

title.description: Title or name of the dish

category.description: Category (Desayunos, Almuerzos, Cenas, Postres, Snacks, etc.)

ingredients.description: List of ingredient objects with name, amount, unit, category, manualUnitCost

imageUrl.description: Optional compressed data URI or photo URL

PantryItem.title: PantryItem
PantryItem.description: An ingredient or provision stocked in the pantry / kitchen inventory with purchase cost tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier of the pantry item (document ID)

name.description: Name of the item or ingredient

unit.description: Unit of measurement (g, kg, ml, l, unidades, etc.)

minQuantity.description: Threshold minimum quantity before restock warning

ShoppingItem.title: ShoppingItem
ShoppingItem.description: An item to buy or verify on the grocery shopping checklist.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping item (document ID)

name.description: Name of the item to buy

isPurchased.description: Whether the item has been marked as bought / available

recipeSource.description: Optional recipe name source that triggered this item

ProductionLog.title: ProductionLog
ProductionLog.description: Immutable audit entry recorded whenever a production batch deducts stock from pantry.

scaleFactor.description: Multiplier applied relative to recipe servings

suggestedSellingPrice.description: Suggested batch selling price based on profit margin

currencyCode.description: Selected currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, MXN)

deductedIngredientsCount.description: How many pantry items were deducted

AppDistributionConfig.title: AppDistributionConfig
AppDistributionConfig.description: Read-only distribution metadata for private APK update notifications and optional licensing.

minRequiredVersionCode.description: Minimum required versionCode before forced update prompt

downloadUrl.description: Private HTTPS link to latest APK release (also accepts updateUrl)

requireLicense.description: Whether license activation is enforced for cloud access

LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: Single-buyer commercial license document managed by seller in Firebase Console.

assignedUid.description: Firebase UID bound to this license upon activation

/users/{userId}.description: Synced Google user profile document scoped by owner UID

/users/{userId}/recipes/{recipeId}.description: User recipes subcollection scoped by owner UID

/users/{userId}/pantry/{pantryItemId}.description: User pantry items subcollection scoped by owner UID

/users/{userId}/shopping_items/{shopping.description: User shopping list items subcollection scoped by owner UID

/users/{userId}/production_logs/{logId}.description: User production history logs subcollection scoped by owner UID

/app_config/{configId}.description: Read-only distribution configuration managed from Firebase Console

/licenses/{licenseCode}.description: Single-use license key validation and binding collection
